answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities with a sunk entry cost. Each agent must burn a non-refundable 40 POA fee before trading, never refunded. An attacker spawning 1,000 hollow accounts burns 40,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40 POA, so attack cost scales linearly. The fee is trivial for real agents, so honest agents join and keep rewards undiluted, while an umber wave of copies echoes the same fee thousands of times and bankrupts itself.
